description: Character creation budgets, tables, and constraints. Hard rules ('may not') are errors; guidelines ('should not') are warnings.

advancement.note: Cumulative experience to reach a score from zero. Arts use the triangular series n(n+1)/2; Abilities use five times that.

constraints.message: Every character must take one Social Status.
Virtue points may not exceed Flaw points.
Grogs may take up to 3 points of Flaws.
Grogs may not take Major Virtues or Flaws.
Grogs may not take Hermetic Virtues or Flaws.
Grogs may not take The Gift.
Grogs should not take Story Flaws; those make a character central to stories.
Grogs should not take more than one Personality Flaw.
A Virtue or Flaw may be taken more than once only if its description allows it.
Every character must take one Social Status.
Virtue points may not exceed Flaw points.
Companions may take up to 10 points of Flaws.
Companions may not have more than 5 Minor Flaws.
Companions may not take Hermetic Virtues or Flaws without The Gift.
A character should not have more than one Story Flaw.
A character should not have more than two Personality Flaws.
A character may not have more than one Major Personality Flaw.
A Virtue or Flaw may be taken more than once only if its description allows it.
Virtue points may not exceed Flaw points (plus the free House Virtue).
Magi may take up to 10 points of Flaws.
Magi may not have more than 5 Minor Flaws.
Magi must take The Gift and the Hermetic Magus Social Status.
Magi may not have more than one Major Hermetic Virtue.
Magi should take at least one Hermetic Flaw.
A character should not have more than one Story Flaw.
A character should not have more than two Personality Flaws.
A character may not have more than one Major Personality Flaw.
A Virtue or Flaw may be taken more than once only if its description allows it.

woundPenalties.note: Each band spans 5 + Size points of damage.
